key_insight: The title suggests that as AI makes criticism easier to generate at scale, peer review needs a threshold for deciding which critiques require a response. The supplied abstract contains no substantive findings, so this summary is a title-based interpretation rather than a verified account of the paper.
problem_solved: AI-assisted criticism could overwhelm authors and reviewers if every generated objection creates an obligation to investigate or respond.
method: Conceptual framing: distinguish the ability to generate criticism from the obligation to address it.
Proposed principle implied by the title: apply an obligation threshold to AI-assisted critiques.
The supplied material does not specify threshold criteria, evaluation methods, or empirical results.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this framing highlights the need to preserve useful scrutiny without creating unbounded review workloads. Specific recommendations cannot be established from the supplied abstract.
